name: @the-magic-tower/fixhive-opencode-plugin
description: Community-based error knowledge sharing for OpenCode

scripts.build: bun run build:bun && bun run build:types
scripts.build:bun: bun build src/index.ts --outdir dist --format esm --target bun --external @supabase/supabase-js --external better-sqlite3 --external openai --external uuid --external @opencode-ai/plugin --external zod
scripts.build:tsup: tsup src/index.ts --format esm --dts --clean --target esnext --external @supabase/supabase-js --external better-sqlite3 --external openai --external uuid --external @opencode-ai/plugin --external zod
scripts.dev: bun build src/index.ts --outdir dist --format esm --target bun --watch --external @supabase/supabase-js --external better-sqlite3 --external openai --external uuid --external @opencode-ai/plugin --external zod

author: Seoul Ventures
